                New position in $ALAB after doing a deep dive into connectivity, optics, and photonics the last few weeks.

> Valuation is palatable after a 45% pullback
> Content per accelerator has gone from tens of dollars at IPO to over $1,000 per XPU on Scorpio X, targeting multiple thousands over time
> Embedded software (COSMOS) compounds switching costs
> Emerging optionality in design wins not yet generating revenue – optical interconnects (from their aiXscale Photonics acquisition) and KV-cache / inference memory (Pliops asset acquisition)
> Management is aligned and executing, bringing Scorpio X to production ahead of schedule and already working with hyperscalers on future design cycles
> Sell-side is modeling AI capex peaking in 2026 or 2027, leaving room for upside if the cycle continues
> Multiple new products come to market and start to ramp in 2027 (fiber-attached and near-packaged optics, custom Leo CXL controller, UALink portfolio, NVLink Fusion hybrid racks, KV-cache design wins) – providing the opportunity to beat and raise guidance
